profile.during_wait_template: Example: suppose you already have an {related_condition} when buying the policy and disclose it. If you need hospitalization for the same {related_condition} after {before_probe_value} months, you are still within the {duration_value}-month PED waiting period, so the PED waiting-period restriction would ordinarily still apply to that treatment
profile.unrelated_condition_template: If you are hospitalized for {unrelated_condition} during this time, the PED waiting period for your {related_condition} does not by itself block the {unrelated_condition} claim; that claim is assessed under the other terms of the policy
profile.after_wait_template: If you need treatment for the same {related_condition} after {after_probe_value} months of continuous coverage, the {duration_value}-month PED waiting period has been completed, so that PED waiting-period restriction no longer applies on that basis; other policy terms still apply
profile.boundary_text: This illustration does not guarantee claim approval or payment
